infoPlist.NSMicrophoneUsageDescription: Used only when you tap the microphone button to send a voice message in chat. Audio is transcribed to text and discarded; nothing is stored without your consent.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: Used only when you tap the Emergency SOS button, to include your location in the alert sent to your contacts. Never collected in the background or continuously.
infoPlist.NSMotionUsageDescription: This app does not use motion or fitness data. This permission is requested only because a location library this app uses references motion APIs to improve accuracy; motion data is never read or stored.

plugins.photosPermission: Used only if you choose to upload a profile photo. Stored on this device only, never uploaded anywhere.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Used only when you tap the Emergency SOS button, to include your location in the alert sent to your contacts. Never collected in the background or continuously.
